chunks: Zurārah narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
The divorce of a pregnant woman is a single divorce, and when she delivers what is in her womb, she has become separated from him.

key_terms.الْحَامِلِ: the pregnant woman; a wife carrying a child
key_terms.بَانَتْ: she became separated; the marital bond ended from him
key_terms.بَطْنِهَا: her womb; the child carried within her
key_terms.طَلَاقُ: divorce; the legal dissolution of marriage

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the divorce of a pregnant woman in Shiʿi hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the divorce of a pregnant woman. It states that her divorce counts as a single divorce, and once she gives birth, her separation from her husband is complete. The narration is significant in Shiʿi fiqh for determining the legal effect and timing of divorce during pregnancy.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4787 - Zurarah narrated from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as):
"The divorce of a pregnant woman is a single divorce, and once she delivers what is in her womb, she is separated from him."
